title: TASC registry index
description: Index of the registries maintained by TASC under registries/ in ga4gh/TASC. Generated by tools/tasc_index from registries/registries.json; do not edit by hand.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the registry README.

url.description: Permanent GitHub link to the README.

hosting.description: repository: entries live in this repository. external: entries are maintained in another repository (see external_url).

defined_by.description: Identifiers of the ADRs, recommendations or governance documents that define the registry. Empty when none does.

data_path.description: Repository-relative path of the registry data file.

external_url.description: Where the entries are maintained when they are not in this repository.
